flows.name: Daily check-in
flows.path: Settings > Trackers > General > Daily check-in card; enable tracker questions under Choose trackers/Habit questions. Open Journals, or All with Journals included under Settings > Lists > Sidebar and All.
flows.source: CheckInCard.tsx, TrackerPills.tsx, individual trackers/*Pill.tsx; NotesView.tsx saves through the existing queue
flows.scope: Browser list/grid completion recorded. Android received browser values and reopened the guided flow in list/grid. macOS mood selection, guided Done and Grid options now observed; detailed tracker values and visual comparison remain.

flows.name: Check-in options
flows.path: Card gear / Check-in options
flows.scope: Skip today, Log another day, Choose trackers, Hide this card, Check-in settings; completed card also exposes Start over. Menu contents depend on state.

flows.name: Another check-in date
flows.path: Check-in options > Log another day
flows.scope: Inline calendar, not a dialog. Android Back backgrounded the app and left the inline calendar state intact. Selecting a date folds it. Do not apply modal-close assumptions here.

flows.name: List/grid
flows.path: List header > Sort and view options > List / Grid / Auto
flows.scope: Device-local choice. The check-in is a band in list and a full-width tile in grid. Android widths recorded without overflow.

flows.name: Quick switcher
flows.path: Jump or Cmd+K
flows.scope: Item results, settings results and command results are distinct. Type > for commands. Do not mistake an empty item result for an unavailable command.

flows.name: Quick add
flows.path: Q outside text inputs, or All > New > Quick add
flows.source: QuickSwitcher.tsx, quick-add parser and creation actions
flows.scope: Browser synthetic journal/event creation recorded. Inspect parsed date/time/type chips before committing. Q while typing must remain text.

flows.name: Journal schedule
flows.path: Create/open a journal > Note options > Entry date
flows.scope: All-day/timed controls and alerts observed. Journal creation and check-in may create different same-day entries.

flows.name: Event schedule
flows.path: All > New > Event, or Jump > >New Event; open its date/schedule
flows.scope: Synthetic event, custom repeat units and end choices observed. Editing a calendar occurrence and its scope confirmation remains distinct from editing the series through search.

flows.name: Recurring edit scope
flows.path: Calendar > Month > a recurring occurrence > All day shortcut > Schedule > All day
flows.scope: Demo “Change this item?” has This occurrence, This and following, All occurrences, Cancel and X. Escape closed only that confirmation and left Schedule open. No scope was committed.

flows.name: Android time picker
flows.path: Synthetic event > Note options > Schedule > Starts or Ends at
flows.scope: Native clock and text-entry modes, Set, Cancel and Clear observed. Cancel returned to Schedule. Browser time input uses text parsing.

flows.name: Alert submenu
flows.path: Dated item > Note options > schedule/date > Alert
flows.scope: Timed offsets differ from all-day day/week plus time. Custom two-week all-day alert rendered as 14 days before at 8 AM. Duplicate Add disabled. None and multiple choices are separate states.

flows.name: Android alert submenu
flows.path: Synthetic timed event > Note options > Schedule > Alert
flows.scope: None, At the time, 5/10/15/30 minutes, 1/2 hours, 1/2 days, 1 week, Custom and minute/hour/day/week units observed. Android Back returned to Schedule. Delivery remains separate from configuration.

flows.name: Contact editor
flows.path: All > New > Contact
flows.scope: Inline detail pane, not modal. Name, phone/email, Add field, PIN hint and Done observed. Birthday/address/profile branches opened; synthetic name saved. Empty optional fields disappear from detail.

flows.name: Contact optional fields
flows.path: Contact edit > Add field
flows.scope: Address, Website, Profile, Company, Job title, Birthday, Date, Related name, Nickname, Middle/prefix/suffix, Phonetic name, Note. Menus and expanded rows recorded; not every value or export round trip tested.

flows.name: Bookmark quick add
flows.path: All > New > Bookmark, or Bookmarks > New
flows.scope: Inline URL field; Add appears with a draft. Invalid URL feedback and valid synthetic bookmark creation recorded. This is not the Clip page modal.

flows.name: Bookmark clipping
flows.path: Open bookmark > Save as note
flows.scope: Observed failure says the page could not be saved and the bookmark is saved. Retained bookmark and inline alert recorded. Success/picture branches still need a suitable page fixture.

flows.name: Clip page
flows.path: All > New > Clip page
flows.scope: Empty Save disabled; invalid address on Enter produces actual field error; Cancel closes. Save pictures toggle and preview/progress branches are distinct.

flows.name: Login
flows.path: All > New > Login
flows.scope: Inline form. Website list, custom fields, password visibility, generator and PIN hint are separate branches. Use synthetic values only.

flows.name: Password generator
flows.path: Login edit > Generate password
flows.scope: Browser demo verified 2026-10-21: Password length preset, Copy success, Passphrase mode with words/separator/symbol options, Apply into draft, Escape closes. Actions use Button. Generated previews excluded from screenshots. Free-account upgrade gate and native behavior remain separate checks. Custom shell still lacks a dialog role.

flows.name: History
flows.path: Open item > History
flows.scope: Wider workspace; compare mode expands further. Catalog's generic history-style fixture does not exercise real history, restore or quota.

flows.name: Empty History
flows.path: Demo event > History
flows.scope: Real empty workspace observed at 1152px width with version limit text, X and no footer. Escape closed it. Initial focus remained outside. Preview/compare/restore require versions.

flows.name: Native About
flows.path: macOS menu > PrivacyNotes UI Review > About PrivacyNotes
flows.scope: Fixed 280 × 485 native window; native close, Escape and settled Cmd+W verified. Resize/minimize disabled. Early Cmd+W before web content settled did not close it; record timing separately.

flows.name: Share/export
flows.path: Open item > Share or export; narrow header may expose it through Note options
flows.scope: Export paths differ by item type. Do not trigger external sharing, purchases or destructive actions merely to obtain a screenshot.

flows.name: Settings search
flows.path: Settings > Search; also Jump settings results
flows.scope: Query clearing and Back-to-results are separate from closing. Registry route list includes platform predicates and source anchors.

flows.name: Tag appearance
flows.path: Sidebar > Actions for tag > Icon and color
flows.scope: Demo icon search empty state, Color tab, Cancel rollback and X persistence verified. First Escape clears search; second closes. Picks save immediately, so X is intentionally different from Cancel.

flows.name: Android custom repeat
flows.path: Synthetic event > Note options > Schedule > Repeat > Custom
flows.scope: Day/week/month/year and Never/date/count endings opened. Zero interval remains visible with Apply enabled; source normalizes the draft interval to at least one. Back twice discarded the draft and retained Does not repeat. A later Apply/reopen pass verifies zero normalizes to one; see android-recurrence-boundary.json.

flows.name: Inline delete
flows.path: Catalog > Actions > DeleteButton; editor attachment > trash; Settings > Trackers > custom habit/factor/medication row
flows.scope: Catalog pointer confirmation, keyboard focus/Enter, Escape and timeout verified. Real demo attachment arm/Escape verified. Three-second confirmation; no explicit blur/outside-click cancellation. Actual deletion and native parity remain unverified. See inline-delete-runtime.json.

flows.name: File upload decision
flows.path: Files > Upload files > choose a .txt file
flows.scope: Demo shows Import or store? with Store as files / Import as notes. Store as files creates an attachment; Upload complete shows Done and per-file status. See media-runtime.json; OS picker and async failures remain platform-specific.

flows.name: Attachment rename
flows.path: Open stored attachment > Rename
flows.scope: Inline File name edits the base name with fixed extension. Save name/Cancel replace attachment actions. Escape cancels. Empty Save closes and retains the original name, without an inline error. Demo synthetic fixture only.

flows.name: Standalone import
flows.path: Sidebar > Import; compare Settings > Import & Export embedded pane
flows.scope: Demo Markdown preview/destination/new-folder import, oversized-note split switch, bookmark folder/browser tags, contact-photo switch, malformed Keep warning, ZIP error, Webcal validation, Back and Escape observed. Android embedded pane and unrestricted file filter measured; see android-import-runtime.json. The standalone shell has Close, tabs, scrolling body and phase-dependent footer. See import-runtime.json.

flows.name: Editor menus
flows.path: Open synthetic note > toolbar Heading / Font / Alignment / color chooser / highlight chooser / Callout / Insert / Attach
flows.scope: Demo choice inventories and Escape captured in editor-menus-runtime.json. Text color and highlight are separate split buttons. Insert has grouped blocks and notation. Attach offers Image/File/Recording. Opening menus does not establish save/reload fidelity for every mark or block.

flows.name: Editor links
flows.path: Toolbar > Add link, or Link to another note
flows.scope: Add link is a dialog with URL focus and selection-dependent Link text. Note-link command inserts [[ at the current selection and opens inline suggestions. A selected image is replaced; start with an appropriate caret for repeatable tests.

flows.name: Find / replace
flows.path: Note options > Find and replace; compact Find via Hide replace
flows.scope: Unmatched query gives 0/0 and disabled actions. Match case changes results; Hide replace swaps to compact Find. Escape does not close compact Find; X or Cmd+F is its close route. This is an inline bar, not a modal.

flows.name: Connections
flows.path: Add a note link > editor slot > Connections
flows.scope: Inline navigation region with Links to count, item buttons and Hide connections. Demo synthetic linked note observed. Backlinks, protected targets and unlinked mentions remain separate branches.

flows.name: Media viewer
flows.path: Editor > select image > View image
flows.scope: Named dialog receives initial focus. Zoom in enables Zoom out; Previous/Next navigate images and reset zoom; end controls disabled; Escape closes. Image toolbar has XS/S/M/L and Copy/View/Download/Delete. Pinch, pan and native viewer variants remain.

flows.name: Read-only note
flows.path: Note options > Read-only
flows.scope: Title disabled, editing toolbar/tags/folder inputs and attachment Rename/Delete disappear; Download/Copy remain. Menu stays open with toggle pressed and can restore editability.

flows.name: Toolbar customization
flows.path: Editor > Customize toolbar
flows.scope: Top/Bottom placement, On bar/Hidden/In + menu regions, per-action movement and location menus. Moved Bold to Hidden and back; bottom position verified.

flows.name: Markdown view
flows.path: Editor > Show markdown > Show formatted
flows.scope: Source mode has a separate fixed set of formatting actions; switching back retains toolbar placement. Source text was not edited.

flows.name: Zen mode
flows.path: Footer > Enter Zen mode
flows.scope: Sidebar/list/footer hidden; tabs remain. Width cycles Default width, Wider, Full width. Show/Hide formatting toolbar works with bottom placement; Exit Zen restores surrounding panes.

flows.name: Statistics drill-down
flows.path: Footer > Open stats > Trackers > Sleep hours > tracker title
flows.scope: Numeric and categorical details; Same day/Next day; Compare with Energy; title opens a nested listbox dialog. Escape closes child while Statistics stays open. Writing > 7 days updates range; parent Escape closes. See statistics-runtime.json.

flows.name: Archive and collapsed panes
flows.path: Note options > Archive; sidebar Archive > note > Unarchive; pane separators
flows.scope: Synthetic archive reveals sidebar destination and removes its attachments from Files; unarchive restores them. Empty Archive view remains reachable while selected. Collapsed icon rail has labelled Tags/Folders/Trash; Tags expands sidebar. List separator collapses list and exposes Expand notes list. See shell-runtime.json.
